The *Cetasikaduka* ("Dyad on Mental Factors") is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh treatise of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Within the intricate combinatory system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it constitutes the 36th dyad of the eighth major division (Patthana 8.36), examining causal relations in terms of the dyad of mental factors (*cetasika*) [SuttaCentral]. No specific secondary literature discussions or published standalone English translations were identified in the dossier.

Its largest overlaps occur with related dyads and triadic combinations, particularly the *Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 2.10; 33 matches), the *Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.10; 12 matches), and the direct combinatory counterpart *Kusalattika, Cetasikaduka* (Patthana 16.17; 11 matches, sharing segments §1.1_0–3.1_2 with §1.1_5–3.1_2) [DharmaNexus]. Other closely aligned sections include the *Sārammaṇaduka* (Patthana 8.34) and the *Piṭṭhiduka* (Patthana 20.8) [DharmaNexus].
